The Hunt · finish options

Hand-drawn finish options

A band-aid that also looks cool: each finish is a post-process over the real game, meant to make the realism gaps (plastic skin, likeness, stiff hands, CG cloth, low-poly trees) forgivable without going cartoon. Same frozen game frames for every option, rendered at phone size (390×844, 2×). Try any of them in the game with ?style=…; ?style=real turns the finish off.

Real

?style=real

Today's plain render, for comparison.

Polished (new default)

default

Gentle edge-preserving paint smoothing that hides CG flaws, soft specular roll-off, a touch of warmth. No lines, no hatching.

Painterly light

?style=painterly

Edge-preserving paint smoothing, soft brush texture in flat areas, a faint silhouette line.

Gouache

?style=gouache

Flatter value bands, matte chalky finish, warm shadows, no lines. Illustrated golf poster.

Ink + wash

?style=inkwash

Faint warm ink silhouette over a soft watercolour wash, paper edges darkening.

Coloured-pencil whisper

?style=pencil

Style 9 at about a quarter: pencil grain only in the shadows, light contour.

Graphic realism

?style=graphic

Crisp silhouettes, slightly posterised shadows, bold rim light. Broadcast illustration.

Soft-focus painterly

?style=dream

Dreamy golden-hour paint: glow on the lights, warm haze, gentle strokes.
